sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: A cloud-native dashboard for a modern medical shop.
body: The primary objective of this project was to deploy a smart dashboard for the "Radha Madhav" medical shop to completely streamline its day-to-day business operations and simplify inventory maintenance. By implementing this cloud-native system design, the pharmacy achieved a blazing-fast point-of-sale billing latency of sub-100 milliseconds and successfully boosted cashier throughput to over 60 line items per minute.

Following the dashboard's integration, Radha Madhav optimized its overall retail performance, driving a ₹4,80,000 increase in quarterly revenue and reducing near-expiry medicine write-offs to less than 0.5% of total product costs.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.heading: Digital transformation for a Mirik pharmacy.
body: Radha Madhav is a medical shop located in Mirik, Darjeeling, that sought to modernize its operations through digital transformation. The client needed a comprehensive solution to streamline day-to-day business operations, simplify inventory management, and enhance overall retail efficiency.

sections.label: The Objective
sections.heading: Transform the entire operational workflow.
body: Studio 1947 was engaged to develop a smart dashboard solution for Radha Madhav medical shop. The primary objective was to deploy a cloud-native system that would completely transform the pharmacy's operational workflow, from point-of-sale transactions to inventory management and compliance logging.

cards.title: Smart Dashboard Development
cards.body: We designed and implemented a specialized, domain-aware management dashboard that unified point-of-sale transactions, distributor procurement pipelines, and automated compliance logging into a single cohesive interface.

cards.title: Offline-First Architecture
cards.body: The platform was built on an offline-first architecture to ensure uninterrupted billing capabilities during network disruptions, a critical feature for rural areas with inconsistent connectivity.

cards.title: Intelligent Inventory Management
cards.body: We implemented an automated First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) allocation engine to manage medicine lots intelligently, reducing waste from expired products.

cards.title: Advanced Features Integration
cards.body: The dashboard incorporated real-time stock-on-hand visibility mapped to specific display racks, optical character recognition (OCR) for parsing doctor prescriptions, and instant drug interaction alerts.
